title: Flatpak and Flathub
description: Install Flatpak and add the Flathub store, so Flatpak apps can be installed. Can remove Flatpak again.
author: Tux Store

download_mb.label: Download size
download_mb.shell: pacman -Si flatpak 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Download Size/ {v=$4; u=$5; if (u=="KiB") v/=1024; else if (u=="GiB") v*=1024; else if (u=="B") v/=1048576; t+=v} END {printf "%d\n", t+0.5}'

installed_mb.label: Installed size
installed_mb.shell: pacman -Si flatpak 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Installed Size/ {v=$4; u=$5; if (u=="KiB") v/=1024; else if (u=="GiB") v*=1024; else if (u=="B") v/=1048576; t+=v} END {printf "%d\n", t+0.5}'

info.note: Sizes are read from your package database. Packages you already have are skipped.

welcome.title: Flatpak and Flathub
message: Flatpak runs apps in a sandbox. Flathub is the main place to get them.
This installs the flatpak package and adds the Flathub remote (system-wide). Log out and in again afterwards so Flatpak apps appear in your menu.

command.label: Checking your system…
shell: [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || { echo "Tux Store is running as root. Start it as a normal user; it asks for the password only when needed."; exit 0; }
for t in pkexec pacman; do
command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The required tool '$t' is missing."; exit 0; }
[ ! -e /var/lib/pacman/db.lck ] || { echo "pacman is locked (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Another package manager may be running. Wait for it to finish, then try again."; exit 0; }

command.label: Looking at what is already installed…
shell: pacman -Si "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue      # not in your repositories: handled below

already_done.title: Already installed
message: Everything in this set is already on your system, so nothing was changed.
If a video still does not play, restart the application.

confirm.title: Ready to install
message: You will be asked for your password.

install.title: Setting up: Flatpak and Flathub
install.message: Please don't turn off the computer until I'm finished.

done.title: Flatpak is ready
message: Flatpak is installed and Flathub is added.
Log out and back in once so applications show up in your menu.

error_generic.title: Something went wrong
error_generic.message: The system check could not run. Please try again.

un_nothing.title: Nothing to remove
message: These codecs were already on your system before, so Tux Store keeps them.
This add-on is now marked as not installed.

un_confirm.title: Remove Flatpak and Flathub?
message: Flatpak will be removed. Apps you installed through Flatpak are kept on disk but will no longer start until Flatpak is installed again.
You will be asked for your password.

command.label: Checking your system…
shell: [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || { echo "Tux Store is running as root. Start it as a normal user; it asks for the password only when needed."; exit 0; }
for t in pkexec pacman; do
command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The required tool '$t' is missing."; exit 0; }
[ ! -e /var/lib/pacman/db.lck ] || { echo "pacman is locked (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Another package manager may be running. Wait for it to finish, then try again."; exit 0; }

un_run.title: Removing Flatpak and Flathub…
un_run.message: Please don't turn off the computer until I'm finished.

commands.label: Removing the codec packages
shell: # Two passes: a package may only become removable after another one is gone.
if pacman -Rns --noconfirm "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "removed $p"; elif [ "$pass" = 2 ]; then echo "kept $p (other software needs it)"; fi

un_done.title: Codecs removed
un_done.message: The packages this add-on installed were removed. Packages that other software needs were kept.
